faq.q: How much does Lopez & Humphries charge?
faq.a: Lopez & Humphries publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does Lopez & Humphries offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Lopez & Humphries does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking.

faq.q: Where does Lopez & Humphries have offices?
faq.a: Lopez & Humphries publishes four offices, among them Lakeland, Bartow and Sebring. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Lopez & Humphries?
faq.a: Lopez & Humphries names four attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Lopez & Humphries publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Lopez & Humphries publishes ten case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Lopez & Humphries?
faq.a: Lopez & Humphries scores 49 and sits at Verified. Passed: entity registration, website and footprint. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
